text: {"answerable":true,"answer":"Meridian enforces rate limits per API key, measured in requests per minute (RPM) using a sliding window. [S2] Limits are applied independently to each key, not to the account as a whole. [S2] The Developer (free) plan allows 60 sustained RPM, a burst ceiling of 100 requests for 10 seconds, and 5 concurrent connections.
